issues: ReadyRow and ContactedRow build their mailto and navigate via `window.location.href = mailto:...` inside an onClick handler, whereas OpenInMessages (used on Detail + NBA + Relationships) uses a plain <a href=mailto:>. Both work, but the anchor form is preferred (right-click Copy Link Address, keyboard access, external-tap behaviour on mobile). Consider unifying the home rows to also use an anchor tag to remove the duplicated buildFirstDraft/buildFollowUpDraft helpers in CommandCenter.jsx and route through OpenInMessages for a single source of truth for subject/body/signature.

critical_code_review_comments: queue.js allowedAction: SMS branches are gone; returns only email_first / email_followup / null gated by exact-string Current Queue + presence of an @-containing email. Strict, correct.

OpenInMessages.jsx: returns null when outreachAllowed==='none' OR no email present — SMS is never substituted when only a phone is on file. One anchor tag with mailto: is the sole render path (pill or panel). Zero side effects on click.
CommandCenter.jsx ReadyRow/ContactedRow: duplicates buildFirstDraft/buildFollowUpDraft from OpenInMessages.jsx. DRY violation — extract to a shared /lib/mailto.js and consume from both. Not blocking.

OpportunityDetail.jsx: Draft-a-Note button removed from action stack; hero uses OpenInMessages panel + ContactResults. queueBucket==='all' branch shows no-outreach-notice and hides OpenInMessages + ContactResults entirely. Correct.
NextBestAction.jsx and Relationships.jsx: PenLine icon is still imported but never used (Draft-a-Note button removed). Minor lint noise — safe to remove imports.

Backend POST /api/opportunities/{id}/handoff endpoint (server.py:787) and api.logHandoff() client wrapper remain but have zero call sites in the UI. Recommend deleting or marking @deprecated to prevent accidental re-adoption.
ContactResults 'I sent it' path uses window.confirm() — the ONE explicit outcome write. Correctly gated to Ready via firstContactOnly filter (mode!=='first_contact' hides it on Contacted).
